suite: PE-09: Validate Boundaries, HITL and Release Readiness

validation_dimensions.details: All 109 domain contract tests pass deterministic validation across discovery, lab, appraisal, safety, claims, regulatory, and provenance.

All 4 HITL outcomes (approve, reject, revise, hold) verified. Decisions are cryptographically bound to dossier hash, product/formula versions, claim/asset versions, locale, and territory. Mutation invalidates authority.
Worker agents (W_PROD, W_DEV, S_VAL) cannot self-approve; forged or mismatched Ed25519 signatures and expired approval periods fail closed.
Offline specialists (appraisal, lab, safety, claims) are restricted to NetworkPolicy.DISABLED; metadata and private IPs are blocked fail-closed; discovery governed egress requires valid grant.
Storage failure prevents durable URI registration; trace bundle referential integrity and W3C PROV hash linkage verified.
